description: End-to-end entitlement, licensing, and quota management workflow for API monetization, from plan discovery and subscription creation through entitlement evaluation, quota tracking, and cancellation or rollback.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for the tenant (organization or account) consuming APIs

customer_id.description: End-customer identifier under a tenant, used for delegated or reseller models

plan_id.description: Identifier for a commercial API plan or product

entitlement_id.description: Identifier for an entitlement record linking tenant/customer to a plan and its capabilities

license_id.description: Identifier for a license artifact (e.g., signed token, key, or contract instance)

quota_pool_id.description: Identifier for a quota pool or bucket associated to an entitlement

policy_id.description: Identifier for a monetization or entitlement policy

functions.name: search_monetization_plans
functions.description: Search and filter available API monetization plans, including pricing, features, and eligibility constraints.

tenant_id.description: Tenant context for plan visibility and custom pricing.

query.description: Free-text search over plan name, description, and features.

filters.description: Structured filters for narrowing down plan catalog.

api_products.description: Filter by API products or bundles included in the plan.

min_monthly_commit.description: Minimum monthly commitment in the billing currency.

max_monthly_commit.description: Maximum monthly commitment in the billing currency.

trial_available.description: Filter plans that offer a trial entitlement.

region.description: Allowed regions where the plan is available.

sort_by.description: Sorting criteria for the plan search.

include.description: Additional expansions to include in each plan result.

functions.returns: Paginated list of monetization plans matching the criteria, with optional feature, pricing, and eligibility details.

functions.name: get_plan_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed configuration of a monetization plan, including pricing tiers, feature flags, and eligibility rules.

tenant_id.description: Tenant context to resolve region and custom pricing.

include.description: Optional data expansions to return with the plan.

view_as_customer.description: Optional perspective of a specific customer to evaluate eligibility and discounts.

functions.returns: Complete plan specification, including features, pricing, eligibility, and whether a given customer is eligible.

functions.name: create_entitlement
functions.description: Create a new entitlement for a tenant or specific customer under a monetization plan, provisioning initial licenses and quota pools.

request_id.description: Idempotency key to ensure create_entitlement is not processed twice.

customer_scope.description: Scope of the entitlement in multi-tenant or reseller scenarios.

scope_type.description: Whether entitlement applies tenant-wide or to a specific customer.

billing_context.description: Billing and commercial context for the entitlement.

metric.description: Name of the usage metric, e.g. 'requests'.

initial_quota_allocation.description: Optional custom quota allocations overriding plan defaults.

limit.description: Maximum allowed for the metric within the period.

burst_limit.description: Optional burst limit allowed for short periods.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for audit and integration.

external_subscription_id.description: Link to an external billing/subscription system.

labels.description: Key-value style labels for the entitlement.

functions.returns: Created entitlement with entitlement_id, associated license and quota pool identifiers, and activation status.

functions.name: get_entitlement
functions.description: Retrieve details and current status of an entitlement, including associated plan, licenses, and quotas.

tenant_id.description: Tenant owning the entitlement (for access control).

include.description: Related resources to expand in the response.

functions.returns: Entitlement object with status, linked plan, quotas, licenses, and optional expanded details.

functions.name: list_entitlements
functions.description: List entitlements for a tenant or specific customer with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

customer_id.description: Filter by customer within the tenant.

has_overage.description: Filter entitlements with current quota overages.

tags.description: Filter entitlements containing all of these label keys.

functions.returns: Paginated list of entitlements and basic status, with filtering and sorting applied.

functions.name: update_entitlement
functions.description: Modify an existing entitlement, including upgrading/downgrading plans, changing status, or adjusting quotas.

request_id.description: Idempotency key to avoid duplicate updates.

updates.description: Fields to update on the entitlement.

effective_date.description: When the new plan takes effect.

quota_adjustments.description: Adjust existing quota pools for this entitlement.

value.description: Amount to increase, decrease, or set as new limit.

effective_until.description: Optional end date for temporary adjustments.

dry_run.description: If true, only return what would change without applying modifications.

functions.returns: Updated entitlement details, or a diff/preview if dry_run is true.

functions.name: generate_license_artifact
functions.description: Generate or rotate a license artifact (token, key, or certificate) for an entitlement.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement for which the license is generated.

license_profile.description: Configuration of the license artifact to generate.

allowed_ips.description: Optional list of CIDR ranges allowed to use this license.

scopes.description: API scopes embedded into the license.

jwt_claims.description: Custom claims to embed when type is jwt_token.

rotation_policy.description: Rotation rules for this license artifact.

regenerate_if_exists.description: If true, existing license of the same type will be rotated.

functions.returns: License artifact details including license_id, secret material or certificate, and validity metadata.

functions.name: evaluate_entitlement_for_request
functions.description: Evaluate whether a specific API request is allowed under current entitlements and remaining quota, and compute applicable limits.

customer_id.description: Optional customer within the tenant when using per-customer entitlements.

license_id.description: License used to authenticate the request, if applicable.

api_call.description: Description of the incoming API request.

api_product.description: Product or bundle identifier of the API being called.

endpoint.description: Path or identifier for the endpoint.

region.description: Region where the request originates or is processed.

attributes.description: Additional attributes for policy evaluation, e.g. 'tier', 'channel'.

policy_context.description: Optional context to evaluate custom policies.

policy_id.description: Specific entitlement policy to evaluate, if not default.

bypass_cache.description: If true, skip policy/entitlement cache for stronger consistency.

functions.returns: Evaluation result containing whether the request is allowed, matched entitlement_id, applied limits, and reason codes for allow or deny.

functions.name: record_usage_and_update_quota
functions.description: Record API usage events against an entitlement and update associated quota pools, with support for batched events and idempotency.

request_id.description: Idempotency key to avoid double-counting identical usage records.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement that this usage applies to.

usage_events.description: One or more usage events to apply in a single call.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the usage event.

dimension_tags.description: Additional dimensions for metering (e.g. environment, region).

overage_behavior.description: How to handle usage beyond quota for this event.

async_mode.description: If true, usage events may be processed asynchronously.

functions.returns: Updated quota status per metric for the entitlement, including remaining quota and overage indicators.

functions.name: get_quota_status
functions.description: Retrieve current quota and usage status for an entitlement across one or more metrics.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement whose quotas should be checked.

metrics.description: Specific metrics to filter on; if omitted, all metrics will be returned.

time_horizon.description: Restrict usage summary to a specific time window.

include_overage_details.description: If true, include any overage charges or threshold breaches.

functions.returns: Quota and usage summary per metric, including limits, consumed amount, remaining quota, and any overage details.

functions.name: suspend_or_cancel_entitlement
functions.description: Suspend or cancel an entitlement, optionally scheduling future cancellation and controlling access shutdown behavior.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for the suspension/cancellation request.

action.description: Whether to temporarily suspend or permanently cancel.

effective_time.description: When the action should take effect; defaults to now if omitted.

block_api_access.description: If true, API access is blocked immediately at effective_time.

reason.description: Free-text reason for suspension or cancellation.

functions.returns: Updated entitlement lifecycle status, effective timestamps, and any resulting license or access changes.

functions.name: retry_entitlement_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed or pending entitlement-related operation, such as provisioning, quota setup, or license generation.

request_id.description: Idempotency key of the original operation to retry, if available.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement associated with the original operation, if any.

backoff_seconds.description: Base backoff in seconds for retry scheduling.

override_params.description: Optional parameters to override for the retried operation (e.g., fixed invalid fields in original request).

functions.returns: Status of the retried operation, including whether it was scheduled or executed immediately and any updated entitlement state.

functions.name: rollback_entitlement_change
functions.description: Rollback a previous entitlement change, such as a plan upgrade/downgrade or quota adjustment, restoring a prior snapshot.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement whose changes should be rolled back.

change_reference.description: Reference to the change to rollback.

change_id.description: Identifier of a specific change event in the entitlement's audit log.

effective_from.description: Alternatively, roll back all changes effective from this timestamp.

rollback_scope.description: Which aspects of the change to rollback.

conflict_handling.description: Policy for handling conflicts with subsequent changes.

functions.returns: Result of the rollback, including new entitlement state, conflicts encountered, and any manual follow-up required.

functions.name: search_entitlements
functions.description: Faceted search across entitlements with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of entitlement summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_entitlements
functions.description: Create multiple entitlements in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created entitlement ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_entitlements
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many entitlements with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each entitlement, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_entitlements
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many entitlements in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each entitlement, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_entitlements
functions.description: Export entitlement datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_entitlements
functions.description: Bulk-import entitlement records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated entitlements.

functions.name: subscribe_to_entitlement_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive entitlement lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the entitlement.

functions.name: get_entitlement_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a entitlement, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the entitlement, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_entitlement_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for entitlements using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the entitlement action.

functions.name: simulate_entitlement_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a entitlement without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the entitlement, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_entitlement_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a entitlement change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the entitlement under change.

functions.name: decide_entitlement_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending entitlement approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the entitlement.

functions.name: add_entitlement_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a entitlement for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the entitlement.

functions.name: upload_entitlement_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a entitlement with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the entitlement.

functions.name: create_entitlement_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a entitlement (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the entitlement version captured.

functions.name: restore_entitlement_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a entitlement from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the entitlement.

functions.name: get_entitlement_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for entitlements over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the entitlement domain context.

functions.name: get_entitlement_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for entitlements combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the entitlement context.

functions.name: create_entitlement_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to entitlements with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current entitlements.

functions.name: evaluate_entitlement_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a entitlement in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the entitlement.

functions.name: get_entitlement_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a entitlement including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the entitlement, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_entitlement_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a entitlement and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the entitlement.

functions.name: assign_entitlement_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a entitlement with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the entitlement with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_entitlements
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more entitlements, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each entitlement.

functions.name: compare_entitlement_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a entitlement with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the entitlement, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_entitlement_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to entitlement operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of entitlement operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_entitlement_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a entitlement and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the entitlement, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_entitlement
functions.description: Clone a entitlement into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned entitlement record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_entitlement_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted entitlement report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the entitlement window covered.

functions.name: escalate_entitlement
functions.description: Escalate a entitlement to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the entitlement.
